description: An abstract PHP class serving as a base controller for REST API endpoints within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a framework for handling HTTP requests with validation, error handling, and response formatting, intended to be extended for specific REST API implementations.

classes.name: AbstractRestController
classes.description: An abstract base class for REST controllers, providing lifecycle handling, validation, and exception management for API requests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes request processing; meant to be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Abstract method for handling GET requests; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Abstract method for handling POST requests; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Abstract method for handling PUT requests; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Abstract method for handling DELETE requests; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize validation rules for GET requests.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize validation rules for POST requests.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize validation rules for PUT requests.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize validation rules for DELETE requests.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Selects the appropriate validation rule collection based on HTTP method.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry for processing an HTTP request; manages validation, dispatches to specific handlers, and manages error responses.
